title: leucanthemopsis cuneata
intro: Leucanthemopsis cuneata, commonly known as Alpenrose, is a plant species in the daisy family native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemopsis cuneata include treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues, making it a valuable remedy in herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
